description_snippet:
About SwiffyLabs 

SwiffyLabs is a next-generation SaaS fintech platform transforming how financial institutions build and scale lending products. Our AI-powered, cloud-native infrastructure enables banks and NBFCs to launch financial offerings with speed and security. We are a high-growth ecosystem—Made in India, built for the world.



The Mission

We are looking for a meticulous and high-ownership Finance Analyst to serve as the backbone of our financial operations. Your mission is to provide the data-driven insights and operational discipline that empower SwiffyLabs to make informed decisions. You will not only manage the day-to-day numbers but also establish the processes and policies that will allow us to scale seamlessly across global markets.



*What you'll do *




Lead end-to-end rollouts of our lending platform for banks and NBFCs, in India and abroad. 
Gather client requirements, configure products and manage go-live to schedule. 
Act as the main point of contact for client stakeholders during implementation. 
Feed field insights back to the product team to improve the platform. 


*What we're looking for *




Proven experience implementing lending solutions for NBFCs or banks. 
Working knowledge of LAP, Home Loan, Gold Loan, Vehicle Loan and Co-lending. 
Strong stakeholder management and execution skills. 


What we expect from everyone 




Extreme ownership: you own outcomes, not just tasks. 
Startup experience: you're comfortable with ambiguity, speed and doing whatever it takes. 
You work from our HSR Layout, Bangalore office 5 days a week.
